meta.name: critical-code-reviewer
meta.description: Conduct rigorous, adversarial code reviews with zero tolerance for mediocrity. Use when users ask to "critically review" my code or a PR, "critique my code", "find issues in my code", or "what's wrong with this code". Identifies security holes, lazy patterns, edge case failures, and bad practices across Python, R, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, and front-end code. Scrutinizes error handling, type safety, performance, accessibility, and code quality. Provides structured feedback with severity tiers (Blocking, Required, Suggestions) and specific, actionable recommendations.

copy.tagline: 审查代码并找出安全漏洞、坏味道和性能问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望有人严格审查你的代码，找出隐藏的问题
